# Bike-share fleet telematics: where we stand

Written by the founder for the board, March 2026.

## Who else sells this

Pedalink sells the GT-4 tracker to city bike-share operators. The GT-4 costs €39 per unit plus €2.50 per month for the data plan. It reports position over LTE-M and runs about 18 months on its battery.

Ridemesh offers a cheaper unit, the RM Lite, at €24 per unit, with no subscription; it relies on Bluetooth beacons at docks, so it has no live position between docks. Ridemesh is owned by Ferrovia Group, which also sells Spokewise.

Spokewise lists its Fleet Pro plan at €4 per bike per month, hardware included, with GPS and LTE-M, and a stated battery life of two years.

## What operators told us

In twelve calls with operators, three themes came up again and again.

> "We lose about forty bikes a month and the trackers die before we find them." (operator, Lisbon)

> "Monthly fees per bike kill our margins; we'd pay more up front instead." (operator, Turin)

> "Bluetooth-only tracking is useless once a bike leaves the dock area." (operator, Porto)

> "Battery swaps are the hidden cost, every truck roll is money." (operator, Lyon)

## Our plan

We think a solar-topped tracker with a one-off price wins.
